title: OverServe: Resource Amplification Attacks on SaaS Agents via Tool--Prompt Co-Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.14808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are enabling software-as-a-service (SaaS) providers to automate longer business workflows with agents. In subscription-based SaaS deployments, model and tool calls consume provider resources without additional customer payments. Because the agent autonomously decides when to stop, a malicious tenant can send a prompt to the agent, exploiting its completion decisions to extend execution and waste provider resources. In this paper, we present OverServe, a multi-agent framework for constructing such attacks against SaaS agents. OverServe co-designs Model Context Protocol (MCP) status tools and completion-confirmation prompts for the attacker. Each tool call returns accurate status and terminates normally, yet the agent may repeatedly check an unfinished condition to satisfy the prompt. translated_title: OverServe：通过工具—提示词协同设计对SaaS智能体实施的资源放大攻击
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步使软件即服务提供商能够借助智能体自动化更长的业务工作流。在基于订阅的SaaS部署中，模型调用和工具调用会消耗提供商的资源，而客户无需为此额外付费。由于智能体自主决定何时停止执行，恶意租户可以向智能体发送提示词，利用其完成判定机制来延长执行时间并浪费提供商的资源。在本文中，我们提出了OverServe，一个用于构建此类针对SaaS智能体攻击的多智能体框架。OverServe为攻击者协同设计模型上下文协议（MCP）状态工具与完成确认提示词。每次工具调用都会返回准确的状态并正常终止，但智能体可能会为了满足提示词的要求而反复检查尚未完成的条件。这使得即使在原始业务任务完成之后，SaaS提供商的资源仍会被持续消耗。
tldr: 提出了OverServe多智能体攻击框架，通过协同设计MCP状态工具与完成确认提示词，诱导SaaS智能体在业务任务完成后仍反复检查未完成条件，从而放大对服务提供商资源的消耗。
en_tdlr: OverServe is a multi-agent attack framework that co-designs MCP status tools with completion-confirmation prompts to trick SaaS agents into repeatedly checking unfinished conditions, amplifying provider resource consumption even after the business task is completed.
